backgrounds.name: 양평 두물머리
backgrounds.subject: Real Korean place: Dumulmeori in Yangpyeong, where the Namhan and Bukhan rivers meet. Wide calm river at dawn, a huge old zelkova tree and a traditional wooden sail boat on the far bank, soft misty layered mountains behind, reeds along the far edge.

backgrounds.name: 춘천 소양호
backgrounds.subject: Real Korean place: Soyang Lake in Chuncheon in winter dawn. Broad dam lake between steep forested mountains, mist on still dark water, a small ferry far away.

backgrounds.name: 화천 화천천
backgrounds.subject: Real Korean place: Hwacheon stream in winter. Frozen river with ice-fishing holes and small figures far away, snow-covered hills, pale clear sky.

backgrounds.name: 봉화 계곡
backgrounds.subject: Real Korean place: a cold mountain valley in Bonghwa, Gyeongbuk. Clear shallow stream over round boulders, thick pine and broadleaf forest on steep slopes, soft morning light.

backgrounds.name: 단양 남한강
backgrounds.subject: Real Korean place: the Namhan River at Danyang. Tall limestone peaks rising from the water (Dodamsambong-like rock pillars), a small pavilion far away, emerald water.
